content: Coarse Memory Layer. This layer maps the context embeddings to the coarse memories. First we use knowledge aided mutual attention (introduced later) to fuse INLINEFORM0 into INLINEFORM1 , the outputs of which are represented as INLINEFORM2 . Then we process INLINEFORM3 with a BiLSTM, whose hidden state dimensionality is INLINEFORM4 . By concatenating the forward LSTM outputs and the backward LSTM outputs, we obtain the coarse memories INLINEFORM5 , which are the question-aware passage representations.
